title: JEJ Trace Options
description: Controls which runtime events appear in the trace output. Structured by the 4-layer mental model: resolve (data), expression (which code produced values), statements (control flow), scopes (structure). Boolean shorthand is expanded by expand-shorthand.ts before this schema is applied — this schema describes the POST-expansion shape.

resolve.description: Data layer — emit ResolveEvents carrying the produced value after every expression-producing event. Default true. Turning off gives context events with no values.

expression.description: Expression layer — which code produced those values.

read.description: Variable value accessed in an expression (x used in `x + 1`).

update.description: Variable written after initialization (x = …, x += …, ++x, x++, --x, x--).

filter.description: If non-empty, only trace variables with these names.

addition.description: + (numeric addition or string concatenation — operand types disambiguate).

shortCircuiting.description: &&, ||, ?? — operators that may skip evaluating the right operand.

conditional.description: Ternary operator ?: (ConditionalExpression). Gated separately from if/else (see statements.conditionals).

filter.description: If non-empty, only trace these specific assignment operators.

increment.description: Increment and decrement operators (++x, x++, --x, x--). Pointcut context gate: controls sub-events (read, arithmetic, update) when originating from an UpdateExpression.

postfix.description: Postfix forms: x++, x-- (returns old value).

in.description: in operator — property existence check (`key in obj`).

void.description: void operator — evaluates and discards (`void expr`).

comma.description: Comma / sequence expression (easter egg — not in standard JEJ). Pointcut context gate for sub-expressions within a SequenceExpression.

filter.description: If non-empty, only trace these specific operators.

literals.description: Literal value events. Each fires before its ResolveEvent.

templates.description: Template literal events. begin/end bracket the evaluation; evaluation fires per ${} expression.

begin.description: Template evaluation starts. Includes static string parts and expression count.

evaluation.description: A ${} expression inside the template is evaluated. Includes index and value.

end.description: Template evaluation complete. Followed by ResolveEvent(kind:'template') with the final string.

properties.description: Property access events (MemberExpression). Each fires before its ResolveEvent(kind:'property').

filter.description: If non-empty, only trace these property names.

functions.description: Function call events. FunctionCallEvent fires before the call; ResolveEvent(kind:'call') fires after with the return value.

call.description: Function called — includes name and arguments.

filter.description: If non-empty, only trace calls to these function names.

statements.description: Statement layer — how execution was controlled.

variables.description: Variable declaration lifecycle events (statement perspective). Read/update events are in expression.variables.

initialize.description: Binding gets its first value. Fires when the declaration line executes (let x = 5 or let x;).

available.description: Binding becomes usable without TDZ error. Fires after initialize.

filter.description: If non-empty, only trace variables with these names.

conditionals.description: if/else events. Ternary ?: is in expression.operators.conditional.

do.description: Body execution marker — fires before every body execution.

setup.description: Initialization phase (runs once before first test).

increment.description: Update/increment phase (runs after each body execution).

forOf.description: for...of loop events. In JEJ, iterates over strings and arrays.

iteration.description: Each iteration — includes the current element value.

scopes.description: Structure layer — scope lifecycle events and variable hoisting (declare events).

script.description: Script-level scope (top-level in normal JEJ programs, or with-statement programs).

interrupt.description: Scope interrupted by break or runtime error.

leave.description: Execution leaves scope. Always fires (like finally).

declare.description: A variable is hoisted into this scope (TDZ start). Fires once per variable at scope creation. Same BindingEvent(declare) type as other declare events.

block.description: Block-level scope — if/else bodies, loop bodies, bare {} blocks.

interrupt.description: Scope interrupted by break or runtime error.

leave.description: Execution leaves scope. Always fires (like finally).

declare.description: A variable is hoisted into this scope (TDZ start). Fires once per variable at scope creation.

with.description: Easter egg — trace the with statement. When active, program runs as script (sloppy mode). Not in standard JEJ documentation.
